plan.notes: Official CSUN 4-Year Degree Road Map (2025-2026 catalog). Degree Road Maps assume successful completion of prerequisites or placement into major-required math courses; see source page. GE placeholder rows are choice slots per the roadmap. Variable-unit rows are encoded at the source lower bound with a documenting choice_note, so encoded semester/plan totals are the minimum achievable and may sit below the roadmap nominal total by the variable-unit spread. "X or Y" rows encode the first-listed code with alternatives documented. Per-course prerequisites are not printed on the roadmap, so prereq arrays are empty; sequencing is the official published placement. SOURCE TOTAL DISCREPANCIES (rows encoded exactly as printed): Sem 3 (Fall — Year 2): source-declared total 15-15 but listed rows sum to 14-14; rows encoded as printed
